# statusdrift_sla_policies (Data Source)

Fetches all SLA policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statusdrift_sla_policies" "all" {}

output "all_sla_policy_names" {
  value = [for p in data.statusdrift_sla_policies.all.sla_policies : p.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.
- `sla_policies` (Attributes List) List of SLA policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sla_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--sla_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sla_policies`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the SLA policy was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SLA policy is active.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the SLA policy.
- `name` (String) The name of the SLA policy.
- `scope` (String) Policy scope: org or group.
- `uptime_target` (Number) Target uptime percentage.
- `window_type` (String) SLA evaluation window type.
